actions: Add a production PrivilegeController transition that restores an Elevated preference to Requested without invoking UAC or starting a Broker
Add a focused unit regression proving the privileged call gate stays closed while background privilege state is Requested
records.reason: LB-014 requires an Elevated permission preference on background startup to restore PrivilegeState::Requested without automatic UAC, while the existing controller exposes only Disabled or enable_from_explicit_user_action, whose production path launches UAC.
records.evidence_ref: PR_CONTRACTS LB-014 required test 'Elevated preference does not auto-trigger UAC on background startup' and docs/05_RUNTIME_CONTRACT.md Background Startup require Elevated -> Requested while ordinary runtime may continue; current src-tauri/src/privilege/control.rs has no no-UAC Requested transition.
